mapper.select: SELECT primary_key as quotationCode ,type , quotation_name, quotation_number, buyer, seller, customer_code, enterprise_code as ownedEnterpriseCode, sell_quotation_belong as userCode, user_name, language, payment_strategy,product_grade, column_titles, amount_title, product_detail,clauses_chs,clauses_en,quotation_time, temp_data,state, data_version, sell_enquiry,sell_filing,buyer_quotation,sign_areas,delete_flag FROM ${tableName} WHERE enterprise_code= #{enterpriseCode} AND state = 'DEAL'

SELECT primary_key, source, contract_name, contract_number,contract_type, buyer,buyer_name, seller, customer_code, enterprise_code as ownedEnterpriseCode, user_code, user_name, language, payment_strategy,product_grade, column_titles, amount_title, product_detail, clauses_chs, clauses_en, state,contract_time, data_version, sign_areas,purchase_contract,sell_quotation,buyer_quotation,temp_data,signed_contract, cancel_reason,sell_order,attachments,delete_flag FROM ${tableName} WHERE enterprise_code= #{enterpriseCode} AND( state = 'UNILATERAL_SIGN' OR STATE = 'MUTUAL_SIGN')
